# `Version`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connection greeting sent to a newly accepted socket, naming the server and (imager only) its firmware version.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager SockeArrival @0xea100, PrintVerInfo @0xb0030; guider SockeArrival @0x6a950; updater SockeArrival @0x25400 (64-bit builds); updater greeting OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |

Sent once to the arriving socket only (single-socket send from the socket-arrival callback), not broadcast. No repeating timer and no application request is needed. Emitted by three servers: the imager on TCP 4700 (channel I), the guider zwoair_guider on TCP 4400 (channel G) and the legacy updater on TCP 4350 (channel U). Each server greets its own sockets; the imager does not forward a guider greeting as its own (the guider socket held by the imager is internal). The guider and updater greetings carry name but not the imager version members. The imager runs its version printer before serializing, so its greeting carries the firmware version and verification flag; the downgrade members appear only on Plus-class and Mini-class hardware when a staged update package with a parsable version is present (READ); other models omit them, and clients MUST treat both as optional. Firmware 9.75 adds main_version and modules (name and version pairs) from the update manifest; their presence condition is INFERRED. The greeting does not establish handshake order relative to other traffic or any authentication gate. Family: custom (not N/S/F); no state or error members. APK consumers: DeviceEventPart, ConnectService, and the legacy firmware-update fragment on 4350.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Version"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `name` | string | yes | - | Server name literal: ASI AIR imager, ASI AIR guider or ASI AIR updater. [READ] |
| `firmware_ver_int` | integer | if imager greeting (4700) | - | Firmware version as an integer (encoding not established). [READ] |
| `firmware_ver_string` | string | if imager greeting (4700) | - | Firmware version string. [READ] |
| `is_verified` | boolean | if imager greeting (4700) | - | Hardware verification result. [READ] |
| `downgrade_fw_ver_int` | integer | if imager greeting on Plus/Mini hardware when the staged package name yields a version | - | Version of a staged update package. Only on Plus-class and Mini-class hardware; optional. [READ] |
| `downgrade_fw_ver_string` | string | if as downgrade_fw_ver_int | - | Same condition as downgrade_fw_ver_int. [READ] |
| `main_version` | string | if imager greeting on firmware 9.75, when the manifest is readable (INFERRED) | - | Firmware 9.75: main version from the update manifest. [READ; presence INFERRED] |
| `modules` | array<object> | if as main_version | - | Firmware 9.75: module list from the update manifest. [READ; presence INFERRED] |
| `modules[].name` | string | no | - | Module name. [READ] |
| `modules[].version` | string | no | - | Module version. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, updater-greeting - Passive-connect greeting on 4350 (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; value invented):

```json
{"Event":"Version","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","name":"ASI AIR updater"}
```

Event, imager-greeting - Imager greeting (READ shape, not captured; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Version","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","name":"ASI AIR imager","firmware_ver_int":2470,"firmware_ver_string":"4.70","is_verified":true}
```
